name: 系统状态
description: 读取 Bot 控制面可见的系统指标，生成状态卡片或文本；工具与指令共用操作，不额外调用模型。
author: Pi IM Bot migration workspace · original behavior: FlanChanXwO

operations.title: 查看系统状态
operations.description: Read OS-visible CPU, RAM, swap, disk, network counters and Bot runtime status from the trusted Bot control plane. Use for system or server status questions. Can return a PNG card or text/JSON. This does not report the plugin Worker or Agent sandbox as the host.

commands.description: 查看系统状态；支持 --card、--text、--json 和 help
